comment: SPURS job binaries embedded in the PPU text of the fixed 1.02 EBOOT, lifted by tools/spu_lift_jobs.py. Each entry is a raw job image, not an SPU ELF, so build_spu_workloads.py --input cannot find it. code_ranges are the instruction spans established by disassembly; the rest of each image is data the job reads from local store (the runtime copies the whole image to LS 0). Inline switch tables inside code_ranges are found and verified by the tool (compiler bound check), not listed here.

evidence: First job of chain 0x11041700 ('chlib/spu/Spu.cpp'); dispatch MISS in work/runtime/logs/boot-fix-1.02-tocspill.log. TOC 0xD96990 holds (0x00CB3580, 0x00000E40).
0x00-0x20: crt entry (ila watermarks, br 0x18, br 0xE0).
0x20-0x60: data. 0xA5 fill, 'JOBCRT Ver14', bss end 0xE00 at 0x3C, bss start 0xC20 at 0x40, init flag at 0x44 (the crt stores 1 there).
0x60-0xAC8: code. Ends with 'bi $r0' at 0xAC4; 0xAC8-0xACC are stop 0 padding.

0xAD0-0xB6C: printf strings ('_exit() has been called', 'Error!! Memory error occurred'); 0xB80: 'JOBCRT Ver' compare key; 0xBA0: relocation list; 0xC00-0xC20: data; 0xC20-0xE00: bss cleared by the crt (Duff loop at 0x5E0); 0xE00-0xE40: '%SPURS JOB INFO%' trailer.

extra_entries: 0x138 is _exit() (ila $r4,0xAD0 then printf and stopd), reached by no direct branch; 0x16C is the epilogue after the stopd at 0x168. Both are lifted so every non-padding instruction in code_ranges is covered.

JOBCRT layout, same crt as 0x00CB3580: 0x00-0x20 crt entry (ila watermarks, br 0x18, br 0xE0); 0x20-0x60 data (0xA5 fill, 'JOBCRT Ver14', bss end 0x45B0 at 0x3C, bss start 0x4330 at 0x40).

0x60-0x4068: code. Ends with 'bi $r0' at 0x4064; 0x4068-0x4070 are stop 0 padding; 0x4070 starts the printf strings ('
_exit() has been called', 'Memory error occurred', chlib source paths), then 'JOBCRT Ver' key at 0x4290, data, bss 0x4330-0x45B0 and the '%SPURS JOB INFO%' trailer at 0x45C0. Every lqr/stqr in the code addresses 0x0-0x40 or 0x40B0 and up, never inside 0x60-0x4068.

The only data inside 0x60-0x4068 is a 5-entry inline switch table at 0x2C14-0x2C28 (words 0x14,0x30C,0x7DC,0x454,0x58C; targets 0x2C28,0x2F20,0x33F0,0x3068,0x31A0): ila $r21,0x2C14 at 0x2AF0, a $r5,$r21,$r126 at 0x2B18, clgti $r8,$r10,4 at 0x2B88, lqx/rotqby/a at 0x2B94-0x2BA0, bi $r2 at 0x2C10. The tool finds and subtracts it (compiler bound check); this is the 'data inside code at 0x2C18' an earlier pass stopped at. The two zero words at 0x3948 follow br 0x38C8; lnop and are alignment padding.

Every other in-code ila to a code address (0x80, 0x150, 0x1818, 0x2260, 0x2AF0, 0x3750, 0x37E0, 0x3A28, 0x3B10, 0x3BE4) is the PIC base idiom (ila rX,next; brsl $r126,next). extra_entries: 0x138 is _exit() (ila $r4,0x4070 then printf and stopd), reached by no direct branch; 0x16C is the epilogue after the stopd at 0x168. The second stopd at 0x3AF0 (memory-error abort) has its epilogue 0x3AF4 seeded by find_spu_functions.
